reviews_5s:
this works really well for milk kefir
it is just right to filter out the the grains without blocking the kefir from passing through
before this strainer with was a lot of work to strain my kefir but this is simple and effective
also the strainer comes shipped in a box that protects the shape so it is perfectly round like a ball the also makes it much easier to scoop out the grains with a silicon spatula
some people say dont use stainless for kefir but it has worked out great for me and the contact time is very minimal and high quality food grade stainless is non reactive especially for short durationsEs una marca Excelente tengo años usándolos y son muy eficientes en la cocina, funcionan para tamizar y colar tanto frío como caliente.All 3 items are sturdy. The strain itself was stiff and durableI have used the standard ones with the wire handles and the spot welded construction. They are cheap to buy and work ok. But these are far above the old style. The handles are larger and comfortable. The front lip rests on edges when needed. The screen is strong and consistent. Clean up is easy. The frame doesn’t flex when shaking. Overall just a more modern, better built and stronger strainer. I like quality kitchen tools and these were worth every penny.I've never been disappointed in any item made by OXO and these strainers are just as we expected from this company. They are great quality, as always. The handles fit your hand perfectly and make it easy to hold onto as you use the lip on the other side of the strainer to rest on your sink to drain liquids or on the edge of your saucepan as you add ingredients. The smaller ones make it super easy to mix your spices together to sift them into your mixture. I highly recommend this set. You can't beat the price or the quality!I use these strainers a lot - especially the little one! They are such good quality and don't rust.My little fine strainer is sooo wrinkled and distorted, I needed to replace it. I love Oxo products, so got this set primarily for the smallest strainer! They are very very sturdy, nest well, clean easily, and I have absolutely no complaints. I wish the smallest strainer was a little finer, but it is still well within my need. I also needed strainers that were not too deep, and these are great--I hate it when I strain something and the strainer is so deep that the liquid covers the first couple of inches of the strainer bottom! Oxo products last forever, and I am very happy to have these. The price was more than fair. They were shipped quickly, packaged well, and arrived safely. I can recommend them unreservedly.I bought this set to replace a ~10 year old similar Oxo strainer where the handle had broken off. It is nice to have multiple sizes available for multiple uses (though I have yet to need the very small strainer and can't imagine what I would use it for), and they can be stacked for easier storage. The middle size is perfect for rinsing 1-2 cups of rice, and the larger size is ideal for cans of beans or medium servings of pasta. The strainers appear sturdy so far and do well in the dishwasher. I hope they will last 10 years like my last Oxo strainer.This set is perfect for my needs. It’s good looking, feels good in your hand and they’re made so well! I’ve had my fair share of strainers that ended up with bent and rusted mesh but this set of strainers does not bend; no rusty mesh, no food getting caught anywhere, just perfect performance with every use. I have washed them by hand and in the dishwasher on the top rack - they still function perfectly and look amazing after almost daily use. I highly recommend this set and almost want to buy another one as back up in case one of the kids takes it outdoors to make mud pies and I never see it again! I’m actually concerned about being without my pretty strainers. Omg I’m officially oldWorked out fine. Need to order more.
reviews_1s: I'm returning the OXO three-piece strainer set that I bought on Amazon today. Even though it was advertised as having a fine mesh, I tested it by putting some Teff grains into it and the grain poured right through the mesh; it didn't hold any of them. So, I guess it's not as fine as I need it to be. Do you have another fine mesh strainer with a tighter weave? If so, I'd like to buy it and give it a try. Thank you very much.Used regularly for 2 years, then it broke (mesh came away from the frame). Yet another product destined for landfill in a short time frame.
